player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''LAGB01''') posted a [[Light]] [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Plead My Case To The Senate]] list on DeckTech in October 2001.

starting.card: Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion

description: Just a Regular normal Podracing Jedi Senate deck. Type II. Please review with that in mind
cards: Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion
posted: I've Decided to go Back
posted: Stay Here Where Its Safe
posted: Speak With The Jedi Council
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting(8)': Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion ('PMCTTS/SAC'), Battle Plan & •Draw Their Fire, Anakin's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber, Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Tatooine: Podrace Arena and Podrace Prep; these count toward the 60.

The description and strategy call this a 'Type II' / 'Ep 1' deck for a closed (Episode I-only) environment; format left as set — Bill to decide. The Coruscant-set Light printing is used for Coruscant.
The strategy says 'I meant Another Pathetic Lifeform instead of battleplan combo'; the list is kept as published with Battle Plan & •Draw Their Fire.
Posted 'Coruscant Senate' dested the Light Coruscant: Galactic Senate (the draft had the Dark page).
Posted 'Queen Amidala' dested Queen Amidala, Ruler Of Naboo (the card titled Queen Amidala is Theed Palace, released after this post).
Posted 'Qui-Gonn's Stick' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Tatooine; Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is Reflections III, released after this post).
The ditto-marked Naboo sites ('“ Swamp', '“ DB', '“ Throne Room', '“ Battle Plains') dested Naboo: Swamp, Naboo: Theed Palace Docking Bay, Naboo: Theed Palace Throne Room and Naboo: Battle Plains.

Other spellings: 'Master Qui-Gonn' → Master Qui-Gon, 'Plo Kloon' → Plo Koon, 'Senator Palpentine' → Senator Palpatine, 'Captian Madakor' → Captain Madakor, 'Supreme Chancelor Valorum' → Supreme Chancellor Valorum, 'Queen's Royal' → Queen's Royal Starship, 'Tatoonie Podrace Arena' → Tatooine: Podrace Arena.
The deck totals 62 cards as published; the 'Weapons/Devices(2)' header lists 4 cards (Qui-Gon's stick, Panaka's Blaster, Naboo Blaster Rifle x2).
